# UsageDeck 0.6.2 beta 1

This beta adds TheClawBay usage and service monitoring, while making upgrades and provider switching more reliable.

## Added

- Added TheClawBay as a provider, including usage and service-status monitoring.

## Improvements

- Keep saved settings through updates and reinstalls. Existing settings move automatically to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\UsageDeckData` on first launch, with no setup required again.
- Keep startup diagnostics outside the installer-owned application directory so reports remain available after an update.

## Fixes

- Switching providers while usage content is still loading no longer closes the Windows interface with layout-cycle error `0x802B0014`.
